metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2026 · O.M: Operation Mole
metas.description: Set across the temple corridors of Tirupati and Tiruvannamalai, an elite undercover operative infiltrates a sprawling transnational red sanders syndicate. As criminal politics escalate, a covert task force launches Operation Mole to dismantle the cartel from within.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2008 · Funny Games
metas.description: Two psychopathic young men take a family hostage in their cabin.
Three intertwined timelines follow the planning and execution of a daring heist in Zurich and its aftermath as an FBI agent pursues a master criminal across Europe.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2026 · Paradise Lost
metas.description: A bus full of children mysteriously vanishes. When an altered version of a grieving mother's son returns years later, she must grapple with the technologically revised reality she has created.

metas.name: 2026 · The Good Daughter
metas.description: The Quinn sisters, Samantha and Charlotte, have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence.

metas.name: 2026 · Heartland
metas.description: Former country star Misty Jones leaves seclusion to search for her missing niece, an emerging musician, in Nashville. Her investigation exposes dark secrets and forces her to face her own past.

metas.name: 2026 · How to Rob a Bank
metas.description: Bank robbers are posting their heists on social media, causing police to chase them.
